Asha (Events): Quick flag: camera A lost PTZ control mid-demo, switching to fixed B. Need to pause for ~2 mins and move Q&A to the end so we can get a clean recording.
Ben (AV): Confirmed. Sending camera control command now and re-pointing to stage center. Backup feed is live on channel fixed-B.
Riley (Host): Okay I'll pause the panel and announce a short break. Moving audience Q&A to the last 20 minutes. Remote folks, drop questions here.
Recorder Bot: HOTSWAP -> recording now using fixed-B: s3://redwood-allhands/alt/3326001111/fixedB-enc-000.ts
Ben (AV): Command I ran:
```
# fallback to fixed camera
ptzctl --set-pos camera-A 0 0 || \
  ffmpeg -i rtmp://fixedB/live -c copy s3://redwood-allhands/alt/3326001111/fixedB-%03d.ts
```
Dina (VP Eng): Host, please ask people to repeat the question out loud when we resume. Also queue roadmap questions first in the Q&A.
Riley (Host): Will do. I'll prioritize roadmap for the first 12 minutes, then open floor. Asking presenters to say the question aloud before answering.
Omar (SRE): Noted the PTZ controller returned a timeout to the control plane. Filing INC-33268 and attaching logs. We'll investigate post-meeting.
Alert Bot: Incident INC-33268 created -> assigned to infra-team.
Asha (Events): Can we add clip markers at the demo start (00:07:05) and camera swap (00:14:30) so editors can trim easier?
Recorder Bot: Clip markers added at 00:07:05 and 00:14:30 -> s3://redwood-allhands/meta/3326001111/markers.json
Ben (AV): Switching player to fixed-B in 20s. Preview should be green once CDN updates.
Riley (Host): Announcement: "Short pause for camera swap. We'll resume in ~2 minutes and move Q&A to the end. Please drop questions here or save them for live. If your question is read out, please repeat it aloud."
Asha (Events): Post-meeting checklist: 1) Ben to upload raw fixed-B segments and checksums, 2) Omar to post incident brief, 3) Recorder to stitch primary+fallback streams and label markers, 4) I'll pin final VOD + timecodes in #all-hands.
Dina (VP Eng): Thanks for the quick failover. We'll start the Q&A with roadmap for 12 minutes then open intl/localized questions.
Ben (AV): Player switched, preview lag ~1s. Monitoring encoder and PTZ controller.
Riley (Host): Resuming now. Reminder to repeat questions aloud.
